label: Folk Storytelling
description: intimate, detail-rich storytelling over simple acoustic instruments.

client_references.explanation: Spare acoustic narrative where concrete detail and a changing refrain carry the story.

production_traits.musical_identity: spare folk storytelling over a picked acoustic guitar, intimate unvarnished vocal and a short refrain whose meaning changes as the story turns
instrumentation: spare picked acoustic guitar as the whole foundation
light shaker or brushed frame drum
small harmonica or mandolin answer between verses
production_traits.rhythm: narrative fingerpicking, unhurried 4/4 or a deliberate 6/8 only where the approved line rhythm supports it

tempo.note: tempo serves the spoken phrase and the detail in the line, never the reverse

production_traits.vocal_delivery: direct, unvarnished lead with plain diction; character-specific language carries the weight, dry upfront vocal

energy_map.consequence: picked guitar alone under the spoken consequence
energy_map.obstacle: concrete visible detail accumulates, accompaniment stays minimal
energy_map.choice: silence or reduced accompaniment marks the emotional turn
energy_map.change: modest bass or one voice of harmony enters on the actual change
energy_map.hook: the short refrain returns with changed meaning after the choice
energy_map.cta: refrain closes on the single CTA with the guitar exposed

production_traits.hook_guidance: short recurring refrain whose meaning changes as choices accumulate; no forced big chorus every few lines
production_traits.spoken_sung_split: spoken passages are deliberate narration, story verses are sung, the refrain is clearly tagged; no rap passages
production_traits.delivery_constraints: no imitation of a particular singer's rasp, accent or phrasing; preserve the client's own language, accent and diction
production_traits.word_fit: longer lines still need complete breaths; choose specific detail over explanatory paragraphs; extra duration earns more consequential beats, not adjective lists
production_traits.story_energy: quiet and cumulative; intensity comes from specifics and consequence, not from arrangement size

duration_guidance.60: one scene, one turn and the changed refrain inside the CTA
duration_guidance.90: two concrete details, one causal turn, refrain returns changed
duration_guidance.120: three-beat story with a spoken bridge and one instrumental answer
duration_guidance.180: add a second location and an object that pays off in the refrain
duration_guidance.300: four consequential beats, one harmonica or mandolin answer, refrain meaning shifts twice
duration_guidance.600: long-form narrative with earned developments and a final refrain that resolves the CTA; no repeated filler

examples: Describe the flour on a returned apron and the unopened letter; the final refrain changes when the letter is read.

section_hint: [Verse] narrated detail, [Refrain] meaning changes, [Verse] consequence, [Refrain] resolved
negative_constraints: no performer imitation or invented accent
